en:
I've got it! Ryoma's body was moved <CLT=cltSTRONG>directly<CLT=cltNORMAL>
from his lab to the gym!

Directly? Don't tell me they threw
the body from window to window.

I mean, we're talking about a body. 
It's not like tossin' a baseball, y'know?

No, I don't believe he was thrown.
But perhaps another way...

What do you mean, another way?
There's no other way to move it—

The culprit must have used some kind 
of <CLT=cltSTRONG>equipment<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Huh? Equipment?

With this equipment, they can connect the
two windows and move the body to the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND><CLT=cltSTRONG>Equipment to connect the windows<CLT=cltMIND>...
I believe it was found near the body...
Ah, um, maybe...that...thing?
Huh? What thing?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Maybe...they used the tank somehow?

That doesn't seem like a realistic way
of moving of body.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Maybe the culprit used the stairs?

That's not long enough to connect the
gym window to Ryoma's lab window.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Ah, um, maybe they...
used the timer from the magic show?
Are you serious...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

The stage used for the magic show.
If you put the stage between the windows...
There's no way that would fit.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Maybe they used the
water in the tank...?
Be stupid on your own time.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
They used the piranha tank.

Just because Ryoma was in there doesn't
mean it could've connected both windows.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
How can you even call yourself a detective?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What was used to connect the
two windows?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>rope<CLT=cltNORMAL> found behind the gym stage could
have been used to connect the windows.

Ohhhh, there was a mysterious mystery about
that rope that only Atua can reveal.
What mysterious mystery?

During last night's preparations for the show,
that rope was in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>wing of the stage<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

But the next morning, the rope had been
moved <CLT=cltSTRONG>backstage<CLT=cltNORMAL> for some reason.

It's a mysterious mystery.
Only Atua knows the answer.

So...during nighttime, someone used the 
rope then threw it into the gym window?

So they *did* use the rope! That's how they
bridged the distance between both windows!
Is the rope long enough to reach both windows?

The rope is roughly <CLT=cltSTRONG>65 feet<CLT=cltNORMAL> in length.
As for the distance between the windows...

According to the sign at the pool, the width
of the pool is roughly 35 feet...

and the distance from the edges of the pool
to the windows is an additional 16 feet...

Altogether, the sum total length from one
window to the other is roughly <CLT=cltSTRONG>50 feet<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

And pool is only thing between
research lab and gym windows...

You bet it's long enough!
Heh! That's what she said!
Wait... Who said that...?

Even if the rope was long enough, wouldn't it
be pretty hard to tie them to the windows?

Both windows were too high to reach. It would 
be like tying a rope from one cliff to another.

If the windows were closer together, then they
could toss the rope across. But they're not...

No! Gonta think it would work!
Just need <CLT=cltSTRONG>one more rope<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Another rope? There was only one, though.
Oh... Then it unpossible... Sorry...

<CLT=cltMIND>No, I'm sure there was another rope. Or at least,
something that could be used as rope.

If you connected a bunch of
handcuffs, it could be used as rope...
What? Dude, no way that'd work!

Wasn't there anything better to
use in Ryoma's research lab?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There was that piece of fabric
that we found in the pool...

But that fabric is too thin to be used
as a rope...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There was only one rope in gym, and
no rope anywhere else...

I guess it's not possible to connect
windows...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Gonta not sure how you supposed to tie
rope to that...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
What was used as the second rope?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>tennis net cable<CLT=cltNORMAL> from Ryoma's lab
could serve as a rope...
How long is it?

About 50 feet or so.
But how did they use it?
Okay, so...

First, culprit hang rope outside of one
window. Then culprit move to other side...
...and tie cable to other window.

Then, after tying to each window, culprit
tie rope and cable together...

That how culprit make one rope that
reach both windows.

Wow! That's amazing, Gonta!
You're so knowledgeable!

I-It's nothing. Gonta use ropes a lot
when looking for bugs.

Even if they did connect the windows with a 
rope, they can't carry a body on just that.
Eureka! I got it!

Thomas Edison once said that genius is
1% inspiration and 99% perspiration...
But in my case, it's 100% inspiration!
We get it, just tell us already.

They handcuffed the body to the rope and slid
it from one window to the other like Tarzan!

The body would reach the gym window,
but it wouldn't land in the piranha tank.

Stop making such dumbass comments, and keep
your smelly breath in your dirty mouth.
Ahhhhhhhhh, ah-ah-ahhhhhhhhhhhhh!
Tarzan!?

Um, but...they also had to put the body in
the piranha tank after they moved it, huh.
That is not feasible with just one rope.

Maybe the rope wasn't the only equipment
the culprit used!
<CLT=cltMIND>Not just the rope...?

Well anyway, it would've been pretty
difficult to get that body in the piranha tank.

They wouldn't just throw it. The trick was
a super crucial part of the culprit's plan.

The culprit must've carefully placed the body
into the tank with their own hands.
But is there really a way to do that?
Kokichi...are you hinting at something?

Huh? Hint? What hint? Don't confuse me 
with your talk of hinting hints.

<CLT=cltMIND>You're confusing *me*!
You were definitely on to something...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's true that the culprit needed to place
the body directly into the piranha tank.

<CLT=cltMIND>If the body were to fall, the culprit
would not have been able to retrieve it.

<CLT=cltMIND>They would have only had
one shot at it, no second chances...

<CLT=cltMIND>So obviously, the culprit would have wanted
to put the body in the tank carefully...

<CLT=cltMIND>Meaning they would have wanted to
get as close to the window as possible.

<CLT=cltMIND>The problem is...how
did they get near it?

<CLT=cltMIND>All that we know right now is that there
was a rope that connected the windows...

<CLT=cltMIND>Somehow, the culprit used that to move the body
and were close to the window themselves.

<CLT=cltMIND>To make that work, they
had to have used something else...

<CLT=cltMIND>But what would that be?
What could they have done—

Alright, Shuichi...
The stage is finally set.
...What?

Listen up! Do a good job here and
I'll be able to put an end to this trial!
It all starts with you!

You be the opening act, 
and I'll be the main event!

And then together, 
we're gonna save everyone!
Together?

You got this!
After all, you are my sidekick!

I believe in you!
So I'm gonna leave the rest to you!
...Yeah.
<CLT=cltMIND>Okay...I can do this!

<CLT=cltMIND>I will solve this mystery
and show everyone the truth!
<CLT=cltMIND>This is the main event.

<CLT=cltMIND>Something was used with the rope to
move the body between the windows...
<CLT=cltMIND>Think... C'mon, think!
